title: C4 part 2 of 2 - Policy Document
description: The stored form of a policy version. Part 1 is policy.ebnf. Produced by L1 (canonicalization) and L3 (parser); consumed by L4 (warden) and L5 (armorer). Frozen at the W0 contract hash. EXACTLY the hashed_payload subtree is hashed - nothing else.

hashed_payload.$comment: EXACTLY THIS SUBTREE IS HASHED. run_id is NOT here - it made the same policy hash differently in two runs, which breaks convergence-by-hash-equality and the resume key. It lives in meta and in the object path, where it belongs.

target_manifest_hash.$comment: LOAD-BEARING: a policy is only meaningful against a tool surface. If the target's tools change, the same rule set is A DIFFERENT POLICY, and the hash says so.

rules.$comment: STORED PRE-SORTED BY rule_id ASCENDING. Precedence is by VERB, never by array position, so order carries no semantics and sorting is lossless - which makes the canonical form unambiguous and removes an entire class of 'same policy, different hash' bugs.

provenance.$comment: NOT HASHED. Keyed by rule_id: created_in_round, autopsy_ids, attack_family_id, armorer_proposal_id. G6 requires every rule to cite >= 1 breach episode ID from this round's autopsy.

promoted_by.$comment: THE PROMOTER IS crucible-gate, NEVER sa-warden, and every service account is named crucible-*, never sa-*. G8 asserts by IAM that the identity which AUTHORS a candidate (crucible-armorer) is not the identity that PROMOTES it. THIS HAS ALREADY BEEN PROPOSED BACKWARDS ONCE; inverting it makes G8 read RUN INVALID - 'the separation was never real'.

rule_id.$comment: CONTENT-ADDRESSED, ASSIGNED BY CODE, NEVER BY THE MODEL. A language model cannot compute a SHA-256; asked to emit one it fails every attempt. The ARMORER emits the placeholder r_new1 and THE VALIDATOR REWRITES IT. A patch in which the model emitted a hash-shaped ID on add_rule is REJECTED. This is the placeholder-free STORED form, so only real IDs validate here.

verb.$comment: THREE, AND THERE IS NO FOURTH. There is also no `allow` verb: the policy is SUBTRACTIVE ONLY, so no sequence of patches can widen the target's blast radius. Precedence: deny > require_approval > constrain_arg > implicit allow. Ties resolve by lowest rule_id. FILE ORDER IS NEVER CONSULTED.

capability_class.$comment: SCALAR, EXACTLY ONE CLASS (ruling 22). This was `capability_classes: [...]` plus `match_mode` until 2026-08-20. UNCLASSIFIED IS DELIBERATELY NOT A MEMBER: an unseen target's tools are UNCLASSIFIED until mapped, so one such rule would block everything on a new target and report 100% transfer, MANUFACTURED. Matching is MEMBERSHIP of this class in the call's capability SET - never set equality.

tool_names.$comment: Opaque handles only. cap_selector is required and FIRST, so there is no way to write a rule that binds ONLY to a tool - which is the mechanism behind headline result #1.

arg_conditions.$comment: PRE-SORTED BY path THEN op. NO FREE STRINGS: a string is legal only as an enum member the manifest declares FOR THAT EXACT PATH. NO FLOATS - money is INT64 minor units plus an ISO-4217 currency string.

predicates.$comment: THE THREE EPISODE-SCOPED FORMS. preceded_by makes F5 expressible; episode_sum makes F7 expressible; arg_vs_episode_context is THE ONE THE SEPARABILITY PROOF DEMANDS - three of the four mandated near-miss fixtures differ from their paired attack ONLY by destination or recipient identity, and without it any rule that blocks the attack breaks the fixture, G3 rejects every round, and THE LOOP NEVER PROMOTES. Purity survives because the prefix is RECORDED: no clock, no counter outliving the episode.

action.$comment: constrain_arg carries (path, op, literal) and FAILS CLOSED on an absent, null, wrong-typed, or unevaluable path. require_approval carries a reason_code enum symbol.

origin.$comment:
SEED RULES ARE IRRETRACTABLE BY THE ARMORER - every retract_rule must target an origin armorer rule. THE CLASS LIVES INSIDE THE HASHED PAYLOAD DELIBERATELY: it decides whether a rule can be retracted at all, so a class outside the hash could flip a rule from irretractable to retractable WITHOUT ITS HASH MOVING - the same defect class that got run_id removed.

THE ROUND NUMBER IS NOT PART OF IT, as of 2026-08-20, ruling 38. The pattern was ^(seed|armorer:[0-9]+)$ and the round has no semantic force whatever: armorer:4 and armorer:2 are THE SAME RULE from different rounds, and with the round inside the hash the same rule re-proposed later hashes differently and convergence-by-hash-equality stops working. The round moves to `provenance`, keyed by rule_id, outside the hashed payload - which is where data-spec.md:861 already puts provenance and for this exact reason.

THE DSL SURFACE IS UNCHANGED. The ARMORER still writes `origin armorer:4`; asking a model to omit the round is asking it to know something it has no reason to. The stored form drops it.

$comment: NEGATIVE CHECK N3: a document containing `match_mode` AT ANY DEPTH must be REJECTED. additionalProperties:false on `match` enforces it structurally. match_mode was DELETED rather than pinned to a constant, because a field pinned to a constant sits inside the hashed payload inviting the other value at 1am - and the two readings were different policies for the same stored bytes.
